title: AI Coding Toolkit Enriched Patch
description: A self-contained enriched patch viewer input containing a full-context unified patch and an element-first index that maps selectable navigation elements to source locations in that patch. The viewer renders the complete file section and uses each location only as a scroll target and changed-line range. Directory navigation nodes are derived from file paths and are not stored as elements.

patch.description: The exact standard unified patch text. Every text-file section must contain full file context so the viewer can render the complete file rather than isolated hunks.

elements.description: Selectable navigation elements keyed by monotonically increasing IDs. Every parentId must reference another entry in this object, and parent relationships must not form cycles.

lineRange.description: Inclusive one-based source line range, expressed as [startLine, endLine]. The end must be greater than or equal to the start.

location.description: A source region within a complete file section of the embedded patch. It selects the file and scroll target but does not limit which diff rows are displayed. oldLines addresses the pre-change file and newLines addresses the post-change file.

file.description: Repository-relative file path used to find the corresponding file section in the patch.

kind.description: The kind of selectable navigation element.

name.description: Display name of the element. A file element uses its repository-relative path so directory rows can be derived from it.

parentId.description: ID of the immediate selectable ancestor. A class has its file as its parent. A method has its containing class as its parent, or its file when it has no containing class.

locations.description: Source locations represented by this element. Class and method locations describe their declarations. File locations capture changed regions not covered by an indexed class or method. Selecting a class or method scrolls to its first new line, or its first old line when no new range exists; selecting a file opens it at the top.
Changed regions not covered by an indexed class or method. Empty when every changed line is covered by a child element.
